meta.description: Four cylindrical units stacked into a deliberately unsteady tower. Every ellipse obeys one camera ratio, so height reads as vertical offset rather than as tilt; every surface on a unit is derived from one OKLCH base walked down a ramp that gains chroma as it darkens; ribs are spaced in angle and projected, so they bunch toward the silhouette. The base drum runs off the bottom of the card, which is what makes the tower feel taller than its frame. Static — no hooks, no motion, zero JavaScript.
